title: Sourdough Starter Peak-Rise Bake-Now Alert
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sourdough:reading
| streamstats current=t max(rise_pct) as peak_so_far
| eval at_peak=if(rise_pct>=peak_so_far AND rise_pct>=80,1,0)
| where at_peak=1
| table _time rise_pct temp_c
description: Watches your starter climb after feeding and pings you when it hits its peak rise, the perfect moment to bake.
value: A starter at peak makes the best loaf; catching that window automatically beats guessing and staring at the jar.
implementation: Feed sourdough-monitor readings (a distance sensor over the jar) into `index=personal`; alert the moment rise reaches its peak.
visualization: Line chart of rise percentage over time with the peak marked.

references.title: Grafana Labs — monitor a sourdough starter

grandmaExplanation: It watches your sourdough grow after you feed it and tells you the exact best moment to start baking.
